title: Add switchable messaging UI V2 and editable profile
goal: Provide an opt-in messaging-style shell with Messages, Tasks, Profile, and Settings tabs while retaining the current UI as the default and keeping Agent behavior shared.
context: The user wants a complete, polished messaging-app interface with editable avatar/profile and a safe way to turn UI V2 on or off. This is presentation-only and must not duplicate or change Agent Runtime.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Agent Runtime, policy, permissions, provider routing, workspace execution, or conversation persistence.
Do not make UI V2 the default; it must remain opt-in until device acceptance.
Do not claim physical-device validation based on CI.
Do not add new project dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: The existing UI remains the default when the UI V2 setting is false or unset.
Settings provides a persistent UI V2 on/off toggle.
UI V2 exposes Messages, Tasks, Profile, and Settings tabs using the existing shared session.
Profile supports editing a display name and bio and selecting a local avatar image.
Avatar data is resized to a bounded 512 by 512 image before persistence.
Turning UI V2 off returns to the existing UI without resetting conversations or Agent state.
Agent Task Contract, M3 / Swift package tests, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Physical iPhone checks confirm tab navigation, avatar selection, and switching V1/V2 before declaring the UI complete.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the UI toggle causes state loss, revert the presentation switch and preserve the existing UI as default. If avatar selection or compilation fails, repair within the allowed paths; do not weaken policy or claim device acceptance.
